One-hot encode long-form sequence states

Source: R/educational_sequences.R
encode_sequences.Rd

One-hot encode long-form sequence states

Usage

encode_sequences(
  data,
  id = "id",
  period = "period",
  state = "state",
  prefix = "state_"
)

Arguments

data

Long-form sequence data.

id, period, state

Column names.

prefix

Generated state-column prefix.

Value

A simulab_sim base data.frame with identifiers and one column per state.

Examples

data <- simulate_sequences(n = 10, n_states = 3, chain_length = 5, seed = 1)
head(encode_sequences(data))
#> <simulab_sim:one_hot_sequences> 6 rows x 5 columns
#>   id period state_State.1 state_State.2 state_State.3
#> 1  1      1             0             0             1
#> 2  1      2             0             1             0
#> 3  1      3             0             1             0
#> 4  1      4             0             1             0
#> 5  1      5             1             0             0
#> 6  2      1             0             1             0
